sinopsis.es: Abel acaba de enterrar a su padre. En busca de las raíces que nunca tuvo y tratando de entender las razones de su suicidio, viaja al pueblo de sus parientes paternos, donde deberá enfrentar las historias inquietantes y las heridas abiertas de la familia que nunca conoció.
sinopsis.en: Abel has just buried his father. In search of the roots he never had and trying to understand the reasons behind his father’s suicide, he travels to the village of his paternal relatives. There, he will confront the haunting stories and open wounds of the family he never knew.
